vision.name: Gotenks
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your attacks are considered Styled and gain "HIT: Destroy the top card of your opponent's Life Deck."
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 1 stage.
Choose 3 cards in your opponent's discard pile and banish them. You may use this attack a second time this combat.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: You may destroy the top card of your Life Deck to gain 5 stages.
vision.note: full-art promo (Japanese name art); edge reads HERO -> MP; Trait badges S, E, F; stats and text compared against S13_BST_56 on the sheet, identical; F badge confirmed as Fusion by the T_Fusion trait card
